description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of two distinct generative AI tasks in journalism as discussed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into two segments: a large red segment labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” and a smaller yellow segment labeled “Headline generation (16.8%).” The central white circle contains the label “Task Type,” and the percentages are explicitly noted next to each segment, indicating that article generation dominates the use cases by a significant margin. The chart uses contrasting colors and clear labeling to emphasize the disparity between the two task types, with no additional categories or legends present.
